about_the_game:
In a world where banners tell tales of glory and whisper of impending doom, you rise as a lord amidst the chaos of medieval warfare. Flow of Banners: Grim Whistles thrusts you into a dark fantasy realm where human kingdoms wage bitter wars against one another, blind to the ancient evil stirring at their borders.

Command Your Retinue, Influence the Battlefield

As a minor lord with grand ambitions, your initial retinue is small, undoubtedly vulnerable against the encroaching darkness. You must quickly hone them into an elite squad of absolute loyalty – your most steadfast anchor in the maelstrom.

Yet, fighting alone is futile. You desperately need allies, but in this war-torn land, trust is scarce and reason is consumed by flame. Even if alliances are forged, the sheer chaos of battle often leaves forces fighting in isolation. Your commands, signaled by banner or embodied by your charge, ripple outwards. You can influence the flow, nudge the tide, but true control over the swirling frenzy is elusive. Still, amidst the deepest desperation, as long as your banner flies, hope endures.

Master the Flow of Battle

Ride the currents of battle, witnessing units surge independently yet cohesively across sprawling fields:

  • Master shifting formations, dictating the rhythm of attack and defense as lines constantly break and reform.

  • Charge with your personal retinue into the heart of combat, turning the tide at crucial moments.

  • Wield banner signals to indirectly guide vast allied forces through the unpredictable chaos of war.

A Dark Tide Rises

What begins as a struggle between human factions soon transforms into something far more sinister. As the situation rapidly escalates, while you navigate the treacherous politics of warring kingdoms, an ancient vampire menace and brutal orc hordes emerge from the shadows, bringing an overwhelming threat that could sweep the continent.

Today's enemy might be tomorrow's last hope. Will you continue to fight your human rivals, or will you attempt to forge unlikely, perhaps even unimaginable, alliances to face this unprecedented crisis? The choice is yours.

Key Features

  • Dynamic Flow Combat: Experience battles where units move like a tide across the battlefield, with formations evolving in real-time, creating an ever-changing tactical landscape.

  • Dual Command System: Directly control your elite retinue while indirectly influencing larger allied forces through banner signals, strategic positioning, and battlefield commands.

  • Dark Medieval Fantasy: Immerse yourself in a grim medieval world stalked by vampires, orcs, and other supernatural threats.

  • Complex Faction Relations: Navigate shifting alliances and treacherous diplomacy where friend and foe become blurred, as human kingdoms must decide whether to continue their internal feuds or unite against the darkness.

  • Evolving Conflict: Witness the war escalate from small-scale skirmishes between human lords to epic confrontations against massive supernatural armies.

Flow of Banners: Grim Whistles immerses you in the chaos of medieval fantasy warfare. Here, your tactical prowess and leadership will determine not just the fate of your house, but potentially the survival of human civilization itself. Will your banners rise victorious, fluttering proudly in the wind, or will they fall silently amidst the grim whistles of the encroaching darkness?
